violated_contract: An onboarding prompt must remain answerable when transcription cannot start, times out, returns an HTTP error, or hears no speech. A recorded answer must have an explicit heard-you receipt before advancing, and a saved answer must have a visible payoff without waiting indefinitely for chat.
canonical_prevention: Gate recording with bounded transcription readiness; preserve distinct failure classes and the transcription path; allow a typed answer through the same reviewed and content-locked save pipeline; present saved facts immediately and bound the optional chat payoff to eight seconds with an always-enabled Continue.
